resources.string: Deletes all sessions, workspace memory/todo/artifacts, run evidence, and debug logs. Provider API keys and MCP toggles are kept. Active runs are stopped.
When a wake starts a new session, and how many are kept
On: every wake starts a new session instead of continuing the last one (except sessions whose background tasks haven\'t reported back)
Off: a wake starts a new session only after a quiet spell; before that the conversation goes on, so \"a bit higher\" still follows on
New session after a quiet spell of
Not used while every wake starts a new session
A wake this long after the last turn starts a new session
Beyond this, starting a new session deletes the least recently used ones with their records and generated pictures; sessions running or waiting on background tasks are kept
